### 2. Respond with Scribe

Activate Scribe and say what you want to say. Scribe reads what's on your screen and understands the full context of what you're responding to. This context helps Scribe write your response with your input.  
​  
It writes the reply right where your cursor is.   
​

Example 1: Replying to an email about a meeting time

The email thread on your screen says:

```
"What time works for you tomorrow? I was thinking 7 PM at Starbucks."
```

What you say:

```
"Say, yes, that works."
```

What Scribe writes:

```
Yes, 7 PM at Starbucks works perfectly for me. See you tomorrow!  
  
Best,   
John
```

Example 2: Responding to feedback on a doc  
​

A teammate left a comment:

```
"This section feels a little long, can we tighten it up?"
```

What you say: [...] ## Final Notes: Just Try It

The easiest way to learn Scribe is to use it on the work you're already doing.

If you spend a lot of your day in email, Slack, or communication platforms, start there.

You don't have to use ChatGPT or Claude to write or rewrite text for you anymore. Press your Scribe hotkey, describe what you want to say, and watch how well it writes it for you.

## What's the Difference Between Dictation and Scribe?

 Dictation is what most people think of when they hear "voice typing." You speak exactly what you want written, word-for-word. Willow transcribes it. It's faster than typing, but you still have to find every word yourself.
 Scribe is different. You speak your intent, and Scribe writes the message for you. You don't need to figure out the words before you start. You just brain dump what you want to communicate. Scribe handles the writing, formatting, and tone.

Title: Willow Scribe: Tell Scribe what to say. It writes the rest. | ChatGate
Willow Scribe: Tell Scribe what to say. Willow Scribe is a new writing mode inside Willow Voice that turns a spoken gist into a finished message in your own style. The Product Hunt launch presents Scribe as part of Willow's voice-first writing product: say what you mean, and Willow drafts the polished email, Slack reply, iMessage, document paragraph, or rewrite in the app where you are already working. ## What does Willow Scribe add to Willow Voice? Willow Voice already works as AI dictation software. The official Willow site describes a hotkey workflow where users speak naturally and get formatted text across Mac, Windows, and iOS. It also highlights automatic editing and formatting, style matching, context awareness for names and technical terms, voice commands, and an AI Mode that turns a few quick words into a polished message. Scribe is best understood as that AI Mode made more explicit for everyday writing. Product Hunt says users can speak the gist of what they want to say, get a ready-to-send message, and highlight existing text on screen to rewrite it in place. It is not only replacing typing; it is converting rough intent into finished communication while trying to preserve the user's voice. Willow's dictation help article says the tool works wherever the cursor is active, including Slack, Google Docs, and Gmail. It also documents a press-and-hold hotkey, a hands-free mode for longer dictations, and context-aware formatting for email-style language. On mobile, the App Store listing positions Willow as an AI dictation keyboard for Mail, Slack, Messages, and Notes, with smart punctuation, auto-formatting, a custom dictionary, rewrite suggestions, and more than 100 languages. The public sources also show a minor documentation mismatch: an older Willow help article says dictation supports 50 languages with more on the way, while the pricing help article and App Store listing reference 100+ languages. Indian VCs describes AI Mode, per-app style matching, and cross-platform voice-to-text for investors and operators. Voibe's Willow review calls Willow a strong cross-platform dictation tool with style memory and AI Mode, while also noting cloud architecture as a decision point; because Voibe sells a competing product, treat its critique as useful but biased. * Product Hunt: Willow Voice and Willow Scribe.
